name: Mission journal
route: No live route; stack-pushed retrospective mission journal opened from Mission Board, Life World, or Me quick links.
annotation: HIFI-73 · no live route · dark shell, top-center orange radial glow. TimelineSpine + mission cards are the singular above-fold focal moment; Safety & Trust footer scrolls in below the fold.

modules.build: Standard iOS status bar on #0A0A0F: time left, signal/wifi/battery right, paper-100 icons. Fixed 44px, no copy.

TopBar (h44), 44px back target left, title 'Mission *journal*' (Hanken Grotesk H1 30, Newsreader Medium Italic on 'journal', the screen's one emphasis word), no trailing action. SegmentedTabs below (y88, h44): [All] selected (bg white 16%), [By domain], [By type]; border white 8%, r24.

GlassStatCard (glass white 4.5%, border white 8%, r28, h104), ChipProvenance 'via missions' anchoring the row. Left: '18' (H1 30) / Overline 'completed'. Mid: '8,420 XP' (H2 24) / Overline 'XP earned'. Right: '4' (H1 30) / Overline 'pivots'. Green #34A853 inner glow, completion context.
SectionHeader (h48). Copy: 'MAY 2026' (Overline 11px uppercase, white 60%). Thin divider line white 8% across width.

TimelineSpine: orange 1.5px path draws top-down from y308. Node1 (green glow, done): SolidCard h180, 'Finished emergency fund', '12 weeks' '1,200 XP', 'Six weeks of discipline. Your fund is real now.', [Finance], ChipProvenance 'via rewards ledger'. Node2 (orange glow, pivot): SolidCard h200, 'Pivoted recipe challenge', 'partial XP' 'your archive note', 'You explored eight recipes before life shifted focus.', ChipProvenance 'via missions'.
Floating Nav Pill (glass white 4.5%, border white 8%, r40). Icons: Today, CIA, Goals, Me. 44px targets. Active: 'Me' (orange #FF5E00 glow).
iOS Home Indicator bar, white 30%, centered, h5px.

belowFold: Continuation of TimelineSpine below APRIL 2026 and MARCH 2026 SectionHeaders: historical completed/pivoted SolidCards following the same layout, honesty, and provenance rules as above the fold. Skeleton state applies during initial load.

SafetyResourceCard link row ('Privacy & safety resources', shield icon, 44px target, Caption white 60%) is scroll-reachable beneath the timeline for journal, mood, stress, sleep, energy, voice, and wellbeing-adjacent moments.
trustControls: ChipProvenance 'via missions' anchors the All-time Summary's completions and pivots counts; honest-null hides the summary card entirely when no entries exist.
ChipProvenance 'via rewards ledger' backs Node 1's '1,200 XP'; XP honest-null reads '--' with 'No mission rewards yet.'
CIA narrative blocks are inline CIAInsightCard-pattern text: low-confidence dims with 'draft from partial data'; honest-null reads 'Summary generating...' while non-CIA facts stay visible.
Archive note honest-null reads 'No note added'; mission duration honest-null reads 'dates unavailable.' — no invented values.
SafetyResourceCard ('Privacy & safety resources') is scroll-reachable below the timeline; source chips include category, source, scope, freshness, retention, export, revoke, and delete.
notes: Route header stays exactly 'No live route; stack-pushed retrospective mission journal opened from Mission Board, Life World, or Me quick links.' — never invent a live route. TimelineSpine is a drawn layout primitive, not a data chart. The screen's one Newsreader Medium Italic emphasis word is 'journal', set in the TopBar title 'Mission *journal*' — the pivot narrative text is plain ('...before life shifted focus.'), no second italic word. Semantic glow is strictly orange = member effort (incl. pivoted missions), green = completion/healthy arrival, purple = CIA synthesis only, never applied to a non-CIA pivot. No streak spectacle or decorative gradients. Reduced motion renders path and cards instantly, filter row appears without slide, thumbnails open with a fade.
